title: Prüfung: Wartezeiten beschreiben und ihre Streuung vergleichen
titleEn: Assessment: Describe waiting times and compare their spread
coverageEvidence: e402f330: Parts3–4 explicitly compute empirical variance/SD with stated divisor, units, comparisons and outlier interpretation;11 points. Tables/location measures are genuinely exercised preparation, without blanket coverage claim.
sourceBoundary: HE G8 physical p25 (printed24) explicitly requires only qualitative spread. Variance/SD is a deliberate existing SkillPilot target supplement and must be designated as such, never presented as an official compulsoryG8 requirement.
